prompt:
WEAPON: Atgeir of Gunnar (군나르의 아트게이르), the spear of Norse myth, wielded in legend by 군나르. Legend: 니알의 사가의 영웅 군나르가 쓴 미늘창. 피를 부를 일이 다가오면 창날이 높게 울었다.

WEAPON LOOK (materials and colors; shape; motifs): long-bladed halberd with a broad spear-axe head and silver-wire bindings, cold iron grey, ash-wood brown and blood red; tall and ringing; sound waves, runic bands and a cut bowstring.

STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and weapon detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.

OUTPUT: the AWAKENED state of the attached action image. Keep the attached image’s camera, pose, framing, subject scale, face, hair, costume and colors exactly. Change only this: her weapon-self ignites with its legendary power (light, aura, runes, elemental effect matching its myth) along the parts of her design that carry the weapon, her eyes and ornaments catch that light, and the air around her reacts. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the weapon wakes.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering on banners or walls, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

HANDS: as in the attached image — ordinary human hands holding nothing. The weapon stays in her armor and design, never a separate object in her hands, beside her or floating near her.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
